verses.1: The seventh month arrived, and the children of Israel gathered in the cities. The people were brought together as one in Jerusalem.
verses.2: And Joshua, son of Jehosadak, and his brothers, the priests, and Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, and his brothers, built the altar of the God of Israel, so that people could offer sacrifices on it, as it was written in Moses’ law. He was a man of God.
verses.3: And they prepared the altar for its use, for in fear of them, the people of the earth would come to worship it. They would go up to it in the morning and in the evening.
verses.4: And they observed the festival of Sukkot as it was written in the Torah. They continued this practice day after day, just as it is commanded by God.
verses.5: And after that, one should always go to the holy places and to all of Jehovah’s sacred events. One should also attend all of Jehovah’s appointed ceremonies.
verses.6: From one day in the seventh month, they began to offer sacrifices to Jehovah. But the Temple of Jehovah was not yet built.
verses.7: And they gave money to the stonemasons and carpenters, as well as food and drink. They also gave wine to the sailors, so that they could carry oak trees from Lebanon to the Sea of Galilee.
verses.8: And in the second year, when they came to the Temple in Jerusalem, during the second month, Zephaniah son of Ciglai and Yeshua son of Yozadkiel began to offer sacrifices. Their brothers, the priests, the Levites, and all those who came from everywhere in Jerusalem also offered sacrifices. They set up the Levites as priests for a period of forty years, so that they could serve God.
verses.9: And Jesus stood with his sons and brothers, Kadiel and his sons. They were all united in their efforts to carry out the work in the Temple of God. Their sons were the children of Henedad, and their brothers were the Levites.
verses.10: And they built the Temple of Yahweh. The priests stood in their positions, with their torches and instruments of worship, to praise Yahweh through David, the king of Israel.
verses.11: And they answered with songs and praises to the LORD. For it is good for ever that His kindness be upon Israel. And all the people praised greatly, singing praises to the LORD for the establishment of the house of Jehovah.
verses.12: And many of the priests, and the Levites, and the leaders of the older women, who saw this house when it was first built, cried out in loud joy. They were filled with great happiness as they looked at this house.
verses.13: And the people do not recognize the sound of joy. It’s a sound that belongs to the people who are in great joy. The people celebrate this joy, and the sound can be heard even in distant places.
